claims.claim_text: The indexed James E. Carroll is confirmed as the Army private whose official entry record matches the OSS index's full name and restricted identifier.

claims.match_notes: The restricted identifier is withheld. Thirty-three other exact-name Army rows carry different identifiers and remain separate.
